look_here_first: This is the other large tree yucca in the batch. Look for a branched or few-trunked crown of broad rigid leaves that are traditionally mostly without marginal threads and not rolled inward at the tip, then confirm with the stouter ovary and fleshy pendant fruit.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: arborescent/tree-like, often several meters tall and sometimes branched

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: broad thick rigid leaves forming terminal crowns

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: traditional Texas key: leaf margins mostly without marginal threads and leaf tips not strongly inrolled

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: traditional key: stout ovary about 7–12 mm diameter at flowering

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dense cream to greenish-cream flower panicle

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: large pendant fleshy succulent indehiscent fruit
